content:
**Rosalynn Jeffries' Shrine** is an unmarked location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

Located slightly south of the West Tek Research Center, the memorial shrine of Rosalynn Jeffries is located at a cliff's edge overlooking the eastern end of the Savage Divide and into the Cranberry Bog / Mire regions. A Deathclaw will reliably spawn next to the shrine.

Rosalynn Jeffries' Shrine appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.
